info.title: Documentation.AI Content API
info.description:
Programmatic access to read and update your documentation, publish deployments, and read analytics.

Each API key is scoped to a single documentation project and carries a role — viewer, editor, or admin — that determines which endpoints it can reach. Because the key identifies the project, no endpoint takes a project identifier.

All dates are UTC. Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings.

get.description: Returns the complete documentation.json file: the navigation tree, branding, SEO settings, and integrations.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch name. Defaults to the deployment branch.

get.description: Performs a hybrid search combining semantic understanding and keyword matching across all indexed documentation pages.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: semanticRatio
parameters.description: Balance between semantic and keyword search. 0 = pure keyword, 1 = pure semantic.

get.description: Returns every file in the documentation repository with its path and size in bytes.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch name. Defaults to the deployment branch.

get.description: Returns the full content of a documentation page by its file path.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File path relative to repository root (e.g. `getting-started/introduction.mdx`)

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch name. Defaults to the deployment branch.

content.description: Raw file content (MDX, JSON, YAML, etc.)

get.description: Returns all branches in the documentation repository.

post.description: Creates a new Git branch in the documentation repository. Requires editor or admin role.

sourceBranch.description: Branch to create from. Defaults to the deployment branch.

post.description: Deletes a branch from the repository. The deployment branch cannot be deleted. Requires editor or admin role.
Merges one branch into another. If the target branch is the deployment branch, this triggers a live deployment.

get.description: Returns pull requests in the documentation repository, filtered by state.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by PR state

post.description: Creates, updates, or deletes documentation files in a single Git commit. Supports up to 20 operations per request. Pushing to the deployment branch triggers a live deployment. Requires editor or admin role.

branch.description: Target branch. Defaults to the deployment branch.

operations.description: File operations to perform in this commit

path.description: File path relative to repository root

content.description: File content. Required for create and update operations. Omit for delete.

branch.description: Branch the changes were pushed to

isDeploymentBranch.description: Whether this push triggered a live deployment

post.description:
Republishes the deployment branch as it currently stands. Commits nothing.

Use it when content reached the branch some other way, or when an OpenAPI specification you reference by URL changed on its own host — nothing changed in Git, so nothing triggered a rebuild.

Requires editor or admin role.

commitSha.description: Specific commit to deploy. Defaults to the current head of the deployment branch.

post.description:
Publishes a branch to its own preview URL. The live site is untouched.

Requires editor or admin role. Returns `403` if your plan does not include preview deployments.

commitSha.description: Specific commit to deploy. Defaults to the current head of the branch.

202.description: Preview deployment queued. Poll `deploymentId` for progress.

branch.description: The branch this preview was built from

422.description: Preview deployment could not be started

get.description: Returns recent deployments for this documentation project, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of deployments to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of deployments to skip

get.description: Returns the current state of a single deployment. Use this to poll a deployment started by `POST /deploy` or `POST /deploy/preview` until its status reaches `ready` or `error`.

parameters.name: deploymentId
parameters.description: The `deploymentId` returned when the deployment was queued

get.description: Total page views and distinct sessions for a date range. Session count is distinct across the whole range, so it cannot be recovered by summing the daily series from `/analytics/traffic`.

startDate.description: Resolved first day of the range

endDate.description: Resolved last day of the range

sessions.description: Distinct sessions across the whole range

get.description: Page views and sessions per day. Days with no traffic are returned as zeroes, so the series always covers every day in the range and can be charted without gap handling.
Pages ranked by view count, highest first. This is a top-N list: it takes a `limit` but cannot be paged, and returns no total.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of pages to return

get.description: Referrers ranked by page views, highest first. Values are reported exactly as received, with `(direct)` for visits that carried no referrer. This is a top-N list: it takes a `limit` but cannot be paged.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of referrers to return

referrer.description: Full referring URL, or `(direct)` when the visit carried none

percentage.description: Share of page views in the range, 0-100

get.description:
Rating totals with one row per page, so you can find the pages readers are least happy with.

The `summary` block covers the whole date range, not just the rows returned. To read the actual written comments for a page, use `/analytics/feedback/comments`.

parameters.name: pathContains
parameters.description: Return only pages whose path contains this text. Case-insensitive substring match against the page path only — it does not search titles or comment text.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column to sort by

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction

satisfactionRate.description: Likes as a share of all feedback, 0-100

summary.description: Totals for the whole date range

total.description: Pages with feedback in the range

get.description: Individual feedback entries for one page, newest first. Only entries that included written text are returned, so a page with ratings but no comments returns an empty list and a total of zero.

parameters.name: pagePath
parameters.description: Exact page path to read comments for

get.description:
Questions asked of the AI assistant, newest first.

Set `maxConfidence` to surface the answers the assistant was least sure of. These are the clearest signal of gaps in your documentation. Questions with no confidence score are left out when you use that filter, since there is nothing to compare against the threshold.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of questions to return. Capped lower than other endpoints because full answer text is included.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Return only questions from one session, to reconstruct a conversation. Cannot be combined with `maxConfidence`.

parameters.name: maxConfidence
parameters.description: Return only questions the assistant scored strictly below this value. Cannot be combined with `sessionId`.

pagePath.description: Page the question was asked from

confidenceScore.description: How sure the assistant was of its answer, from 0 to 1. Null when the answer was not scored.

get.description: Thumbs up and down left on individual AI answers, newest first. The `summary` block covers the whole date range, not just the returned page of results.

questionId.description: Identifier of the answer that was rated

answerSnippet.description: Opening of the rated answer, truncated when the rating was captured

summary.description: Totals for the whole date range

satisfactionRate.description: Likes as a share of all ratings, 0-100

get.description: Questions asked and distinct sessions per day. Days with no questions are returned as zeroes, so the series always covers every day in the range.

sessions.description: Distinct sessions that asked at least one question that day

apiKey.description: API key generated from the Documentation.AI dashboard (Settings → API Keys). Pass as `Authorization: Bearer dai_...`

Forbidden.description: API key role does not have permission for this operation. Write endpoints require editor or admin role.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist, or belongs to a different documentation project

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Check `x-ratelimit-limit` and `retry-after` response headers.

AnalyticsUnavailable.description: The analytics store could not be reached. The request was valid — retry after a short delay.

StartDate.name: startDate
StartDate.description: First UTC day to include, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to six days before `endDate`. The range must not exceed 90 days.

EndDate.name: endDate
EndDate.description: Last UTC day to include, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Inclusive — the whole day is counted. Defaults to today.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Combined with `total`, this is how you page through results.

message.example: Date range must not exceed 90 days (requested 152)

QueuedDeployment.description: Returned when a deployment is accepted. The build has not run yet — poll `deploymentId` until its status reaches `ready` or `error`.

url.description: Where the result will be published

Deployment.description: A recorded deployment and its current state.

status.description: `pending` and `building` are in progress; `ready`, `error` and `cancelled` are final.

url.description: Published address. Null until the deployment succeeds.

branch.description: Branch this deployment was built from

isPreview.description: True for preview deployments, which never affect the live site

triggerType.description: What started it: `user` (dashboard), `auto` (repository push), `system` (internal), or `api` (this API).

logs.description: Failure detail. Populated only when status is `error`, null otherwise.
